snippet.title: A2 Racer II - Etappe 2: Amsterdam - Den Haag (1998) [WINDOWS]
snippet.description:
A2 Racer is a racing computer game series, from Dutch game company Davilex Games. The series started with the game A2 Racer in 1997, in the Netherlands, in which the player has to race over the Dutch A2 highway. In A2 Racer II and other sequels, the racing expanded to other places in the Netherlands and Europe. The game series was published in Europe under different names, like London Racer and M25 Racer in the UK, Autobahn Raser in Germany, and Paris-Marseille Racing in France.

In A2 Racer II you get to race through Amsterdam, the highway from Amsterdam to The Hague, The Hague, the highway from The Hague to Rotterdam, Rotterdam, the highway from Rotterdam to Amsterdam and has a great finale through Amsterdam with even more police trailing you.

You can get extra points for hitting speed-radars.

Specs: PII 166, 16MB RAM, 2MB Video Card, 50MB HD

This game contains cars like the Trabant, Opel Astra, Volkswagen New Beetle, BMW Z3, Porsche 911, Mercedes CLK GTR and a Lamborghini Diablo, but under different names.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nostalgic value for retrogamers in the Highest HD quality you can find on Youtube! All in 1080p and 60fps!
